name: @aave-v4-positions/api
description: Read API serving indexed and enriched Aave v4 positions

scripts.start:dev: pnpm run build && concurrently -k -n tsc,app -c blue,green "tsc -p tsconfig.build.json --watch --preserveWatchOutput" "node --watch --enable-source-maps dist/main.js"
scripts.start:debug: pnpm run build && concurrently -k -n tsc,app -c blue,green "tsc -p tsconfig.build.json --watch --preserveWatchOutput" "node --watch --inspect --enable-source-maps dist/main.js"
